verse: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him…
prayer: Lord, like Hannah I can only say thank you. You heard every prayer I prayed, spoken and unspoken, and now {name} is here, warm and real in my arms. Today begins a whole year of praying for this little one. Teach me to bring {name} to you every morning, and never to forget that this child came from your kindness before anything else. Amen.

verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
prayer: Father, you call children a heritage and a reward, and holding {name} I believe it. I did not earn this gift and I could never pay for it. Help me to treat {name} as your treasure placed in my care, not as something I own. Fill our home with gratitude today, even in the tiredness, and let every feed and every cuddle feel like receiving a gift. Amen.

verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
prayer: Father of lights, every good and perfect gift comes from you, and {name} is the best gift I have ever been given. You do not change like the shadows. On days when I feel unsteady, remind me that your goodness toward {name} stays the same in the morning, at midnight and tomorrow. Let my thanks be as steady as your love. Amen.

verse: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
prayer: Lord, you know what it took to bring {name} into the world: the waiting, the pain and the fear. Thank you that joy has come, the joy that a new person is born into the world. Heal every body and heart in our family that is still recovering. Let the joy of these days grow deeper than the memory of the hard hours. Amen.

verse: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
prayer: Gracious God, when people meet {name} and ask whose child this is, let my first answer be that you have graciously given us this child. Keep me humble and amazed. Thank you for the visitors, the meals and the kind words that surround us right now. Let {name} grow up knowing that every good thing in life comes first from your grace. Amen.

verse: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
prayer: Creator God, you knit {name} together in secret, long before I could see a face or count tiny fingers. Every part of this little body was formed by your careful hands. Keep each part growing strong: heart and lungs, mind and muscle, eyes and ears. When I worry about what I cannot see, help me trust the One who made {name} so carefully. Amen.

verse: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
prayer: Lord, this is the day that you have made, and you have given it to {name} and to me together. I want to rejoice in it, even if it holds broken sleep and endless washing. Open my eyes to the small gifts in it: a yawn, a grip on my finger, a moment of quiet. Thank you for this first week. We will be glad in it. Amen.

verse: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
prayer: Lord, my keeper, I cannot watch over {name} every second, but you can. Keep {name} from all harm, and guard every going out and coming in, from the first trip outside to every doorway this child will walk through in years to come. Watch over us in the car, at the doctor and at home. You keep us now and forever, and I rest in that. Amen.

verse: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
prayer: Father, thank you that you put your angels in charge of {name}. I picture them standing close by the cot, guarding every breath and every turn. When I check on {name} again and again in the night, settle my heart with this promise. Guard this little life in all its ways today, and guard me too, so I can care well for the child you have given. Amen.

verse: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
prayer: Lord, you never slumber and you never grow tired of watching over us. I get tired, and my eyes close even when I want to keep them open. Thank you that {name} is never without a guardian, because you are always awake. Keep {name} steady and safe today, and let me rest without guilt, knowing the One who keeps us does not sleep. Amen.

verse: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
prayer: Eternal God, you are our dwelling place, and underneath {name} are your everlasting arms. When I lay {name} down, I lay this child into arms far stronger than mine. Hold us both when we feel fragile. Push away whatever would harm this little one, and make our home a place where your presence is the safest place of all. Amen.

verse: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance.
prayer: Lord, you are a hiding place for {name}. When the world feels loud and big, surround this little one with your peace and with songs of rescue. Thank you for the lullabies I sing, however tired my voice is. Let them be prayers as well as songs. Preserve {name} from trouble, and let our home be filled with the music of your care. Amen.

verse: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
prayer: Father, you say, do not be afraid, for I am with you. Some days I am afraid of so many things for {name}: illness, accidents, the unknown. Hold us up with your strong right hand. Strengthen me when I feel weak, help me when I do not know what to do, and keep {name} upheld by your faithful love every single day. Amen.

verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
prayer: God, you are our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. You are not far away when {name} cries and I cannot find the reason. You are right here. Be present in our home today: at feeding time, at bath time, in the long evening. Whatever trouble comes, let {name} always find in you a refuge that never moves. Amen.

verse: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
prayer: Father, tonight I lay {name} down in your care. Quiet every fear, settle every cry, and let {name} sleep in safety, knowing that you alone make us live in safety. Give me rest too, and patience for the long nights. When I wake to feed and soothe, let me find you already there, keeping watch over both of us. Amen.

verse: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
prayer: Lord, you promise that when we lie down we need not be afraid, and our sleep can be sweet. Give {name} sweet sleep tonight, deep and peaceful. Protect this little one from bad dreams, from discomfort and from anything that would disturb a gentle rest. And when sleep is short in our house, make the minutes we do get truly restoring. Amen.

verse: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
prayer: God who sustains us, {name} lay down and slept and woke again because you held on through the night. Thank you for every morning that we wake together. I do not take a single sunrise for granted. Sustain {name} through every sleep this week, and sustain me through every wake-up, with enough strength for each new day. Amen.

verse: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
prayer: Father, you give sleep to those you love. I confess I often try to carry everything myself, rising early and staying up late, as if it all depends on me. Teach me to rest in you. Give {name} the gift of good sleep, and help me to receive rest as your gift too, without worry or guilt. Amen.

verse: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
prayer: Lord, you neither slumber nor sleep. You were awake before {name} was born, and you will be awake long after I close my eyes tonight. What a comfort that is to a tired parent. Watch over {name} through the dark hours, and let this little one grow up knowing a God who is always attentive and always near. Amen.

verse: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
prayer: Father, when I lie awake in the night watches, let me remember you. Turn my restless thoughts into quiet prayers for {name}. In the hours when the house is dark and only the two of us are awake, let your presence fill the room. Make the night feeds holy ground, where I learn to talk with you while I hold {name}. Amen.

verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you call the weary and heavily burdened to come to you, and you promise rest. I come now, tired, carrying {name} and all my worries. Take what is too heavy for me. Give {name} a peaceful heart, and give me the kind of rest that sleep alone cannot give: rest for my soul in your gentle care. Amen.

verse: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
prayer: Lord, as Jesus grew in wisdom and stature and in favour with God and people, let {name} grow in every way. Help this little body to grow strong, this mind to grow curious, and this heart to grow toward you. Give {name} good friendships and a good name. Let me notice and celebrate each small step of growth along the way. Amen.

verse: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
prayer: Father, let {name} grow strong in spirit and be filled with wisdom, with your grace resting on this little life. Long before {name} can understand words, let your grace be at work. Let our home be a place where wisdom is spoken and shown. Fill {name} with your grace today, and fill me with it too, so I can parent with patience. Amen.

verse: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
prayer: Lord, you are the source of all wisdom, knowledge and understanding. I want {name} to be clever, but even more I want {name} to be wise. Speak your truth into this growing mind. Let curiosity lead {name} toward you. And when I do not know the answer to my child’s questions, remind me that I can always ask you. Amen.

verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
prayer: Generous God, you give wisdom to anyone who asks, without scolding. I am asking today. I lack wisdom in so many parenting decisions: feeding, sleeping, when to worry and when to wait. Give me wisdom for {name}, freely and generously. Help me to listen for your voice among all the advice, and to trust the wisdom you give. Amen.

verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
prayer: Lord, the fear of you is the beginning of wisdom. Let {name} grow up with a holy wonder at who you are: not afraid of you, but in awe of your greatness and goodness. Plant reverence and joy side by side in this little heart. And let me model that wonder, so {name} sees what it looks like to love and honour you. Amen.

verse: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
prayer: Father, happy is the one who finds wisdom. I pray that {name} would find wisdom early, and that it would bring a deep and lasting happiness, not only the passing kind. Guide {name} to good teachers, good books and good friends. Let wisdom be something {name} treasures and goes looking for, all through life. Amen.

verse: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
prayer: Lord, from infancy {name} can begin to know your word. Let our home be full of scripture spoken, sung and lived. Even now, as {name} hears my voice reading these verses, let something of your truth settle in this little heart. Make {name} wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus, and let that wisdom grow year by year. Amen.

verse: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
prayer: Lord, you know the plans you have for {name}: plans of peace and not of evil, to give a hope and a future. I do not know what this child will become, but you do. Help me to hold my own hopes loosely and trust your good plans. Lead {name} step by step into the future you have already prepared. Amen.

verse: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
prayer: Father, your eyes saw {name} before birth, and every day of this little life was written in your book. Nothing about today surprises you. When I worry about tomorrow, remind me that you have already seen it. Fill each of the days written for {name} with your presence, your protection and your love. Amen.

verse: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
prayer: Creator God, {name} is your workmanship, made for good works you prepared in advance. What a thought, that you already have kindness, courage and service planned for this little one. Shape {name} into the person you designed, and help me to notice and nurture the gifts you have placed inside. Let {name} walk in the good things you have prepared. Amen.

verse: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ…
prayer: Faithful God, you began a good work in {name}, and you will complete it. When I feel I am getting parenting wrong, remind me that you are the one who finishes what you start. Keep working in {name} through every season of life. I trust you to carry on what you have begun, long after my part is done. Amen.

verse: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
prayer: Lord, I have so many plans for {name}, and I make them with love. But you direct our steps. Guide this family where we need to go. Close doors that would hurt {name}, and open doors that lead to life. Help me to plan carefully but to hold every plan open to you, because your direction is always better than mine. Amen.

verse: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
prayer: Lord, you will fulfil what concerns {name}. Your loving kindness endures forever. You do not abandon the work of your hands, and {name} is the work of your hands. Fulfil every good purpose you have for this child. On the hard days, remind me that you are not finished, and that your faithful love will not let go. Amen.

verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
prayer: Father, you promise that all things work together for good for those who love you. Some days do not feel good: the crying, the worry, the exhaustion. Weave even these hours into something good for {name} and for our family. Teach {name} to love you, and let this child grow up seeing your goodness in every season. Amen.

verse: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
prayer: Good Shepherd, you gather the lambs in your arms and carry them close to your heart, and you gently lead those who have young. That is me, Lord. Gather {name} close today. Lead me gently too, with patience for my mistakes. Show me how to be as tender with {name} as you are with all your little ones. Amen.

verse: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up…
prayer: Lord, love is patient and kind. Teach me to love {name} with that kind of love, especially when I am tired and my patience runs thin. Let my voice be gentle and my arms be kind. When I fail, forgive me and help me start again. Let {name} grow up surrounded by love that is patient, steady and unselfish. Amen.

verse: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering…
prayer: Father, help me to clothe myself today with compassion, kindness, humility and perseverance. These are the clothes I need for parenting {name}. Some days I put on frustration and hurry instead. Change my wardrobe, Lord. Let {name} see your character in me, and let this little one grow up wearing kindness too. Amen.

verse: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love…
prayer: Lord, teach our household to bear with one another in love. A new baby changes everything, and we are all learning. Give every member of this family humility and patience with each other. Let {name} be welcomed into a home where love covers our tiredness, and where gentleness is our habit. Amen.

verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath…
prayer: Father, help me to be quick to listen to {name}, slow to speak and slow to become angry. Even now, every cry is a kind of language. Teach me to listen well and to respond with calm. As {name} grows, let our home be a place where everyone is heard, and where anger does not rule. Amen.

verse: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
prayer: Lord, I do not want to grow weary in doing good. The feeds, the nappies and the rocking are good work, even when they feel endless. Remind me that this season will bear fruit in due time. Give me strength to keep caring for {name} with love, and let me see glimpses of the harvest along the way. Amen.

verse: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer…
prayer: Father, help me to be joyful in hope, patient in trouble and faithful in prayer today. Some days I need all three. Fill me with hope for {name}’s future, patience for the present moment and a habit of turning to you. Let my prayers for {name} be steady, like a heartbeat in our home. Amen.

verse: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
prayer: Lord, let your words be on my heart, so that I talk about you naturally with {name}: when we sit at home, when we walk outside, when we lie down and when we wake up. Even now, let our everyday moments become little lessons of your love. Make faith a normal, joyful part of {name}’s life from the very start. Amen.

verse: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
prayer: Father, unless you build the house, we labour in vain. Build our home, Lord. Build it on your love, your truth and your peace. Watch over {name} in this house when I cannot. Let every room be filled with your presence, and let {name} grow up in a home that you have built and that you guard. Amen.

verse: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
prayer: Lord, a simple meal where love is beats a feast where there is strife. I do not need a perfect house or fancy things for {name}. I need love at our table. Fill our home with kindness, laughter and peace, even when things are messy. Let {name} remember a childhood rich in love more than in possessions. Amen.

verse: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
prayer: God of wisdom, a home is built by wisdom and established by understanding. Fill the rooms of our home with treasures that matter: patience, forgiveness, joy and faith. Give us understanding as parents. Let {name} grow up surrounded by the beautiful treasures of a home that is built on you. Amen.

verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
prayer: Father, above all, let love be earnest in our home. Love covers a multitude of failures, and there will be many as we learn to care for {name}. Let love be quicker than criticism and forgiveness quicker than blame. Wrap {name} in a family where love is the first and the last word. Amen.

verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
prayer: Lord, above all these things, help us to walk in love, which binds everything together. When we feel pulled in different directions by tiredness and stress, hold our family together with your love. Let {name} feel that love every day: in our arms, in our voices and in the way we treat each other. Amen.

verse: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
prayer: God of love, love comes from you. Every bit of love I feel for {name} is a reflection of your love. Teach {name} to love others, because love is of God. Let this little heart be born into your love and grow up knowing you. Make our family a place where people see what your love looks like. Amen.

verse: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you took the children in your arms and blessed them, laying your hands on them. I bring {name} to you today. Take this little one in your arms. Lay your hands of blessing on this small head. Let {name} know, long before understanding words, what it is to be held and blessed by you. Amen.

verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
prayer: Father, help me to train {name} in the way to go, so that when this little one is grown the path will not be forgotten. I cannot control the future, but I can begin today with love, prayer and example. Give me consistency and grace. Let the seeds planted now grow deep roots in {name}’s heart. Amen.

verse: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
prayer: Lord, you have been our God from the womb. Before {name} could do anything, you were already caring for this little life. Let {name} learn to rely on you from the very beginning. Let trust in you be as natural as breathing. And let this little one grow into a life that always praises you. Amen.

verse: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
prayer: Father, from the lips of babies and infants you have established strength. Even {name}’s first sounds can praise you. You delight in the smallest voices. Let the coos, the babbles and someday the first words of {name} be a song of praise. Remind me that you do great things through small ones. Amen.

verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
prayer: Lord, as you called young Samuel by name, call {name} one day too. Give this little one ears to hear your voice and a heart that answers, speak, for your servant is listening. Let our home be a place where your voice is welcome, and where {name} learns to listen for you from a young age. Amen.

verse: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
prayer: Father, the psalmist calls children to come and listen and learn the fear of the Lord. Let our home be that kind of invitation for {name}. Teach me to speak of you with gentleness and joy, so that reverence feels like love and not like fear. Give me the right words and the right example, so that {name} finds you beautiful and wants to come close. Amen.

verse: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.
prayer: Lord, from birth {name} has been cast upon you, and from the womb you have been this child’s God. What a beginning: to be held by you before anything else. Let {name} never know a day without you. Hold this little life securely through every stage, and let your claim on {name} be the deepest truth of all. Amen.

verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
prayer: Creator God, I praise you, because {name} is fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful, and I know it more deeply every time I watch this little one breathe. Let {name} grow up knowing that truth deep down, never doubting being made with care. When the world says otherwise, let your voice be louder: you are wonderfully made. Amen.

verse: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
prayer: Father, you created us in your own image, and {name} carries that image. In this small face I see a reflection of your creativity and love. Let {name} grow up with dignity and worth that no one can take away. Help me to honour your image in this child every day, in how I speak, how I touch and how I listen. Amen.

verse: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
prayer: Lord, {name}’s frame was not hidden from you when it was being made in secret. You saw every bone forming and every heartbeat beginning. Thank you for watching over those hidden months. Keep watching over the growth that is still happening inside: the brain making connections, the body getting stronger. Nothing about {name} is hidden from your care. Amen.

verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
prayer: Father, you are the potter and we are the clay. {name} is the work of your hands, soft and new. Shape this little life with your gentle hands. Help me to remember that I am not the one who forms {name}’s heart; I am a helper in your workshop. Make me a careful, patient helper. Amen.

verse: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
prayer: God, when you looked at everything you had made, you said it was very good. I look at {name} and I say the same: very good. Thank you for the goodness of this little body and this new personality. On days when I feel I am not good enough, remind me that you call your creation good, including me. Amen.

verse: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
prayer: Lord, you made us and we are yours. {name} belongs first to you, a lamb in your pasture. That frees me from thinking I have to be everything for this child. You are the Shepherd. Feed {name}, guide {name} and keep this little one close to your flock all life long. Amen.

verse: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
prayer: Father, you have granted {name} life and steadfast love, and your care has kept this little spirit safe. Every day of life is your gift. Thank you for each morning that {name} wakes up warm and breathing. Continue to watch over this precious life with your kind attention, today and every day. Amen.

verse: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
prayer: Lord, you are the healer. When {name} is unwell, heal this little body, and we will be healed. When I am weary and run down, heal me too. You are our praise, the One we turn to first. Give the doctors and nurses who care for {name} wisdom and skill, and let every treatment work for good. Amen.

verse: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases…
prayer: Lord, I tell my soul to praise you and not to forget a single one of your benefits: you forgive our sins and heal our diseases. Thank you for every illness {name} has avoided and every one that has passed. Strengthen this little immune system. Protect {name} from infection and harm, and fill me with gratitude for the health I so easily take for granted. Amen.

verse: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
prayer: Father, I pray that {name} may prosper in all things and be in good health, just as this little soul prospers. Let body and soul grow strong together. Bless {name}’s eating, sleeping and growing. And above all, let this child’s soul flourish in your love, so that health is not just of body but of heart. Amen.

verse: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
prayer: Lord, you heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds. When {name} cries from a hurt I cannot see, bring comfort. When I feel broken by worry or exhaustion, bind up my heart too. Let our home be a place of healing, where hurts are soothed and tears are wiped away with love. Amen.

verse: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
prayer: Father, let the sun of righteousness rise over {name} with healing in its wings. Let this child go out and leap with joy, like a calf released from the stall. I long to see {name} running, laughing and full of life. Bring health and freedom into this little life, and let joy overflow. Amen.

verse: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
prayer: Lord my God, I cried to you, and you heard me. I have prayed for {name} in moments of fear, and you have answered. Thank you for every healing you have already given. When I am anxious, remind me of your past faithfulness. Keep {name} healthy, and keep teaching me to cry out to you first. Amen.

verse: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
prayer: Father, let your light break out like the morning over {name}, and let healing come quickly. Go before this little one in every step, and let your glory be a rear guard behind. Surround {name} with your presence front and back. Let health and light be part of every day of this young life. Amen.

verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
prayer: Lord, you keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steady because they trust in you. My mind races in the night. Steady it. Help me to fix my thoughts on you as I hold {name} in the dark. Give this little one perfect peace too, and let our home be calm because we trust in you. Amen.

verse: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
prayer: Father, even the darkness is not dark to you; the night shines like the day. When {name} wakes in the dark and cries, you see clearly. Nothing in the night is hidden from you. Let {name} never be afraid of the dark, because you are there. Let your light fill our home through every night. Amen.

verse: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
prayer: Lord, by day you command your steadfast love, and at night your song is with me. As I sing softly to {name} in the dark hours, let it be your song: a prayer to the God of our lives. Make our nights full of your presence, and let {name} fall asleep to songs of your love. Amen.

verse: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day…
prayer: Father, let {name} not fear the terror of the night or any danger by day. Guard this little one through every hour. When I hear a noise in the night and my heart jumps, calm me. You are watching over our home. Let peace replace fear, for {name} and for me. Amen.

verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you spoke to the wind and the waves, peace, be still, and there was a great calm. Speak that same peace over {name} when this little one cannot settle. Calm the crying, calm the colic, calm my racing heart. Let a great calm settle over our home tonight. Amen.

verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
prayer: Father, weeping may last for the night, but joy comes in the morning. Some nights feel long, with tears from {name} and sometimes from me. Thank you that morning always comes. Carry us through the hard nights and greet us with joy at dawn. Let {name} wake up to a home full of gladness. Amen.

verse: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
prayer: Lord, my eyes stay open through the night watches. Let me use these waking hours to think about your word. As I feed and rock {name} in the quiet of the night, bring verses and promises to my mind. Turn the night shift into a time of meeting with you. Amen.

verse: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
prayer: Father, as young Samuel grew and found favour with you and with people, let {name} grow too. Let this little one be loved by you and liked by others. Give {name} a good heart and a kind way with people. Let favour follow this child into every room and every relationship. Amen.

verse: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
prayer: Lord, blessed are those whose strength is in you. Let {name}’s strength come from you, not only from food and sleep but from your presence. Set this little heart on a lifelong journey toward you. Make {name} strong in body and in spirit, finding strength in you on every road. Amen.

verse: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
prayer: Father, you give power to the faint and strength to the weak. {name} is so small and fragile, and some days I feel just as weak. Increase our strength together. Help {name} to grow sturdy, to feed well and to gain a little more every week. And give me the strength I need to keep going through these demanding, beautiful days. Amen.

verse: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil. It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
prayer: Lord, teach {name} not to be wise in personal opinion but to honour you and turn from evil. Let that respect for you bring health to this little body and nourishment to these growing bones. Let wholeness come from walking with you, and let {name} grow strong in every way. Amen.

verse: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
prayer: Father, let {name} flourish like a palm tree and grow strong like a cedar. Let this little life stand tall and steady, rooted in goodness. Give {name} healthy growth: strong limbs, a sound mind and a resilient heart. Let this child grow into someone who flourishes and brings shade and shelter to others. Amen.

verse: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
prayer: Lord, you are our strength and shield. My heart trusts in you, and I am helped. When I worry about {name}’s health, help me to trust you. Be {name}’s strength and shield every day. Let my heart leap for joy, and let my song be thanks to you for this little one. Amen.

verse: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
prayer: Father, make {name} strong in you and in the strength of your might. Not proud strength, but the kind that comes from leaning on you. When this child faces challenges, let strength come from you. And make me strong in the same way, so I can show {name} how to rely on you. Amen.

verse: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
prayer: Lord, I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth. That is my deepest wish for {name}. More than success, more than comfort, let this little one walk in truth all life long. Help me to live truthfully, so that {name} learns truth by watching me. Amen.

verse: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
prayer: Father, teach me your way, so I can walk in your truth and teach {name} to walk in it too. Give me an undivided heart that honours you. Let our home be built on truth, and let {name} grow up seeing what a heart wholly devoted to you looks like. Amen.

verse: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
prayer: Lord, lead {name} in your truth and teach this little one, for you are the God of salvation. I wait for you all day long. As I care for {name} through each hour, let my waiting be full of hope. Guide this child into truth step by step, through every stage of life. Amen.

verse: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you are the way, the truth and the life. Let {name} come to know you as all three. When life feels confusing, be the way. When lies are loud, be the truth. When things feel empty, be the life. Let {name} find the Father through you, and walk with you gladly from childhood to old age. Amen.

verse: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
prayer: Father, you say that knowing the truth will set us free. Let {name} grow up free: free from shame, free from fear, free from lies about being unloved. Teach this little one your truth, and let it bring a lifetime of freedom. Make our home a place where truth is spoken kindly. Amen.

verse: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
prayer: Lord, you have shown us what is good: to act justly, to love mercy and to walk humbly with you. Let {name} grow into someone who does all three. Let this child be fair, kind and humble. And let me show {name} the way by living it every day. Amen.

verse: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill? He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
prayer: Father, who may live near you? The one who walks in integrity and speaks truth from the heart. Let {name} be that kind of person: honest inside and out. Plant integrity deep in this little heart. Let {name} grow up close to you, living a life that pleases you. Amen.

verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
prayer: Lord, those who wait for you renew their strength. They rise up with wings like eagles; they run and do not grow weary; they walk and do not faint. I am weary. Renew my strength for caring for {name}. Lift me up today, and let me run this race of parenting without fainting. Amen.

verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
prayer: Father, your grace is sufficient for me, and your power is made perfect in weakness. I feel so weak some days, unsure of what {name} needs and afraid of getting it wrong. Let your power rest on me. Fill the gaps where I fall short. Let {name} grow up seeing your strength shining through my weakness, and learn that it is safe to need you. Amen.

verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
prayer: Lord, I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me, including the night feeds, the endless washing and the quiet worry. Strengthen me today for every task that {name} needs. When I think I cannot do one more thing, give me the strength to do it with love, and the humility to ask for help when I need it. Amen.

verse: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
prayer: Father, my flesh and my heart may fail, but you are the strength of my heart forever. When my body is exhausted and my emotions are frayed, be my strength. Hold me together so I can hold {name}. You are my portion, and you are enough for both of us. Amen.

verse: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
prayer: Lord, you are the God who arms me with strength and makes my way smooth. I need strength for every step of caring for {name}. Smooth out the rough places in our days. Give me sure feet and a steady heart, so I can walk faithfully through this season. Amen.

verse: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
prayer: Father, on the day I called, you answered me and gave me strength in my soul. I am calling to you again today, tired and stretched thin. Answer me. Encourage my heart. Fill me with fresh strength for caring for {name}, and let me feel your encouragement in my soul. Amen.

verse: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
prayer: Lord, you give strength to your people and bless them with peace. Bless our home with both today. Give me strength for every feed, every change and every walk around the room. Give {name} peace in body and spirit, a settled tummy and a calm heart. Let strength and peace be the twin gifts that fill our days together. Amen.

verse: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children; To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
prayer: Father, your steadfast love is from everlasting to everlasting, and your righteousness reaches children’s children. Let your love reach {name}, and one day {name}’s children too. Let this family be part of a long line of people who love and honour you. Begin that blessing in this little life today. Amen.

verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
prayer: Lord, you are with us, mighty to save. You take great delight in {name}. You quiet this little one with your love, and you rejoice over {name} with singing. What a picture: you singing over my child. Let {name} feel your delight. Let me sing over {name} with the same joy. Amen.

verse: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
prayer: Father, you have done great things for us, and we are filled with joy. {name} is one of the great things you have done. Thank you for this gift. Let our home be full of laughter and gladness. Let {name} grow up in a family that celebrates your goodness every day. Amen.

verse: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
prayer: Lord, you make known to us the path of life, and in your presence there is fullness of joy. Show {name} that path. Let this little one find joy in being close to you. Fill our home with your presence, and let the joy there be deep and lasting, not just passing happiness. Amen.

verse: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
prayer: Father, the angel brought good news of great joy for all people. Let {name} grow up knowing that good news: that Jesus came for everyone, including this little one. Let joy, not fear, shape {name}’s faith. And let our home be a place where good news is shared gladly. Amen.

verse: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you spoke so that your joy would be in us and our joy would be complete. Let your joy live in {name}. Let this little heart be full of joy that comes from you. Fill my heart too, so that my joy spills over onto {name} every day. Amen.

verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
prayer: God of hope, fill {name} with all joy and peace in believing, so that this little one may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. Let hope be the atmosphere of our home. Let {name} grow up hopeful, joyful and at peace, because you are faithful. Amen.

verse: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
prayer: Lord, bless {name} and keep this little one. Make your face shine on {name} and be gracious. Turn your face toward {name} and give peace. I speak this ancient blessing over my child today. Let it rest on every part of {name}’s life, now and in all the years to come. Amen.

verse: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
prayer: Father, pour your Spirit on {name}, and your blessing on all who come after us. Let this little one spring up like grass and like willows by flowing streams. Let {name} grow fresh and green, watered by your Spirit even in dry seasons. Make this child flourish in every season of life, rooted beside your living water and never far from it. Amen.

verse: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
prayer: Lord, increase {name} more and more in every good way: in health and strength, in wisdom and kindness, and most of all in faith. Thank you for adding {name} to our family; our home is fuller and brighter because of this little one. Keep increasing your goodness to us and through us, so that our children and their children are blessed. Amen.

verse: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us…
prayer: Father, be merciful to us and bless us, and make your face shine on us. Shine on {name} today. Let this little one feel the warmth of your face like sunshine. Let your mercy and blessing surround our home. Make us a family that reflects your light to everyone we meet. Amen.

verse: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing…
prayer: Lord, as you promised Abraham, bless {name} and make this little life a blessing to others. Let {name}’s name be known for goodness and kindness. Let this child be a channel of your blessing to family, friends and strangers alike. Bless {name} richly, and let that blessing overflow into a world that needs it, starting with the people closest to home. Amen.

verse: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
prayer: Father, bless {name} when coming in and bless {name} when going out. Bless the morning feeds and the evening baths, the first outings in the pram and the homecomings at the end of the day. Let every coming and going of this little life be wrapped in your blessing. Nothing in {name}’s day is too small or too ordinary for your care. Amen.

verse: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ…
prayer: Blessed are you, God and Father, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in Christ. Let {name} receive every one of those blessings, not because of anything this child has done, but because of your generous heart. Let this little one grow up rich in grace, mercy, peace and love. Thank you that {name} is already held in such blessing. Amen.

verse: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
prayer: Lord, you are good, and your love endures forever. I want to start today with thanks, before the busyness takes over. Thank you for {name}: for the smiles that have started to come, for the little sounds, for the weight of this growing body in my arms. Your love was here yesterday and will be here tomorrow. Let thanks be the first language {name} hears in our home. Amen.

verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
prayer: Father, you ask us to give thanks in every circumstance, not only the easy ones. So I thank you for {name} on the calm days and on the hard ones, in the giggles and in the crying. Teach me a thankful heart that does not depend on everything going smoothly. Let {name} grow up in a home where gratitude is woven into the ordinary hours. Amen.

verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
prayer: Lord, I want to enter your gates with thanksgiving and your courts with praise. Even our small home can be a place of praise. As I carry {name} from room to room today, let my heart be thanking you. Let {name} learn early that coming close to you is a glad thing, full of song and thanks, never a burden. Amen.

verse: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
prayer: Father, I will give you thanks with my whole heart, not a half-hearted thanks muttered between chores. I will tell of your wonderful works, and {name} is one of them. Let me tell {name}, again and again as the years go by, of all the ways you have been faithful to our family, until this child can tell those stories too. Amen.

verse: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
prayer: Lord, let the peace of Christ rule in our hearts, and let us be thankful. When the house is noisy and plans fall apart, let peace be in charge, not stress. Rule over my reactions today. Let {name} feel a calm, grateful spirit in the people around this little cot, and grow up knowing that peace and thanks belong together. Amen.

verse: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
prayer: Father, let us come into your presence with thanksgiving and make a joyful noise with songs. Our home has plenty of noise right now; let some of it be joyful praise. Thank you for {name}’s voice, for every coo and squeal and laugh. One day let that voice sing to you with joy. Today, let me sing for both of us. Amen.

verse: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night…
prayer: Lord, it is good to give thanks to you, to declare your steadfast love in the morning and your faithfulness at night. You have seen {name} and me through every morning and every night so far. Let our days be bookended by thanks: a grateful word when we wake and another when we lie down. You have been faithful at every hour. Amen.

verse: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
prayer: Father, cover {name} with your feathers, and under your wings let this little one find refuge. Your faithfulness is a shield around our family. When the world feels too big for someone so small, let {name} rest in the shelter of your care, warm and protected, the way a chick rests beneath its mother’s wing. Amen.

verse: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings…
prayer: Lord, keep {name} as the apple of your eye, and hide this child in the shadow of your wings. You look at {name} with tender attention, more carefully than I ever could. Guard this little life the way we guard what is most precious to us. Let {name} always be close to your heart and safe beneath your care. Amen.

verse: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
prayer: Father, how precious is your steadfast love. People of every kind take refuge in the shadow of your wings, and now {name} joins them. Thank you that your shelter is wide enough for everyone, and close enough for one small child. Let {name} grow up knowing that your love is a place to run to, always open and always safe. Amen.

verse: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
prayer: Lord, be merciful to us. In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge until the storms pass. Some days bring storms: illness, sleepless nights, worries I cannot name. Shelter {name} and me until they pass. Teach me that your wings are not only for emergencies, but a place to live every day with my child. Amen.

verse: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings.
prayer: Father, let {name} dwell in your tent forever, and take refuge in the shelter of your wings. I want this child to make a home in your presence, not just to visit when there is trouble. Let your nearness be as familiar to {name} as our own front door, and let this little one feel at home with you all life long. Amen.

verse: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
prayer: Lord, you have been our help, and in the shadow of your wings we sing for joy. Thank you for helping us through these first months with {name}. When I look back, I see your help everywhere. Let our home be full of songs of joy under your care. Let {name} grow up singing, sheltered and glad. Amen.

verse: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings…
prayer: Father, like an eagle stirring up its nest and hovering over its young, you spread your wings and carry your little ones. As {name} grows and begins to explore, be the one who hovers near. Catch this little one when needed and carry {name} on your wings. Teach me when to hold close and when to let my child stretch and try. Amen.

verse: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
prayer: Lord, I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother. I want that kind of quiet trust: not demanding, just resting near you. Let {name} grow up with that same calm confidence, resting in our love and in yours. Quiet my anxious heart today, so that {name} can rest in my arms the way I rest in yours. Amen.

verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
prayer: Father, you say, be still and know that I am God. Stillness is rare in our house these days, but I pause now with {name}. You are God, and I am not. You are in control, and I can let go. Let this moment of stillness spread across our day, and let {name} feel the calm that comes from knowing you are near. Amen.

verse: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
prayer: Lord, the fruit of righteousness is peace, and its effect is quietness and confidence forever. Grow righteousness in our home, so that peace grows too. Let {name} live in an atmosphere of quiet confidence, not anxiety. Let our family be known for a deep, settled peace that comes from living close to you, even when life is full and loud. Amen.

verse: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
prayer: Father, my soul finds rest in you alone, and my salvation comes from you. I am tempted to find rest in routines, in sleep schedules and in getting everything right. But only you give true rest. Let {name} learn early that peace is found in you, not in having life under control. Be our rest today. Amen.

verse: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
prayer: Lord, it is good to wait quietly for your salvation. I am not always good at waiting: for {name} to sleep, to settle, to feed well. Teach me patient, hopeful waiting. As I wait, let me trust that you are working. Let {name} grow up with a quiet, hopeful heart that knows how to wait for good things. Amen.

verse: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
prayer: Father, you will fight for us; we need only to be still. I do not have to win every battle for {name} by myself. You are fighting for our family. Help me to stop striving and trust you more. Let {name} grow up knowing that you go into every battle on this child’s behalf, and never leave the field. Amen.

verse: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
prayer: Lord, my soul waits in silence for you alone, because my hope comes from you. In the busy hours of caring for {name}, help me find small silences to turn to you: a minute at the window, a deep breath during a feed. Let my hope rest in you, and let {name} grow up seeing a parent who waits on God. Amen.

verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
prayer: Father, let {name} be like a tree planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in season, with leaves that do not wither. Plant this little one deep near your living water. Let {name} grow steady and strong, nourished by your word, and fruitful in every season of life, including the dry ones. Amen.

verse: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
prayer: Lord, blessed is the one who trusts in you, whose confidence is in you. Let that be {name}’s story. Let this child put trust in you, not in money, popularity or achievement. Begin building that confidence now, as {name} learns to trust our arms. Let our faithful love point to your even greater faithfulness. Amen.

verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
prayer: Father, let {name} be like a tree planted by water, sending roots down to the stream. When heat comes, let this child not fear; when drought comes, let the leaves stay green and the fruit keep coming. Give {name} deep roots in you, so that hard seasons cannot uproot this young life. Amen.

verse: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
prayer: Lord, let {name} be rooted and built up in you, established in faith and overflowing with thankfulness. Let faith grow in this child like a house on good foundations: steady, strong and full of gratitude. Help me to lay those foundations now through prayer, song and love, one ordinary day at a time. Amen.

verse: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love…
prayer: Father, let Christ dwell in {name}’s heart through faith, and let this little one be rooted and grounded in love. Before {name} learns anything else, let this child learn love: yours and ours. Let love be the soil {name} grows in, so that every part of life draws strength from it. Amen.

verse: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
prayer: Lord, those planted in your house will flourish in your courts. Plant {name} in your family, among people who love you. Let this child grow up surrounded by a church family that cares, prays and celebrates. Let {name} flourish in that community, and always feel at home among your people. Amen.

verse: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock…
prayer: Lord Jesus, everyone who hears your words and does them is like a wise person who built a house on the rock. Let {name}’s life be built on that rock. When storms come, as they will, let this child stand firm. Help me to lay that foundation now, by living out your words in front of {name}. Amen.

verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
prayer: Father, your word is a lamp to our feet and a light to our path. As {name} takes the first steps of life, light the way. When the path ahead is unclear, let your word shine just enough for the next step. Help me to keep your word glowing in our home, so that {name} grows up walking in its light. Amen.

verse: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you are the light of the world. Whoever follows you will not walk in darkness but will have the light of life. Let {name} follow you and never walk in darkness. Shine on this little one in the nursery, at the window and out in the world. Fill {name} with the light of life. Amen.

verse: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
prayer: Father, you promise to instruct us and teach us the way we should go, and to counsel us with your eye upon us. Keep your loving eye on {name}. Teach this little one the way to go, through me and through others who love you. And teach me, so I can guide {name} wisely. Amen.

verse: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
prayer: Lord, when we turn to the right or the left, let our ears hear a voice behind us saying, this is the way, walk in it. Give {name} ears to hear your gentle guidance throughout life. When decisions come, let this child know your voice and follow it, choosing well at every turn. Amen.

verse: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
prayer: Father, the path of the righteous is like the first light of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until full day. Let {name}’s life be like that: growing brighter each year, with more love, more wisdom and more faith than the year before. Let this little dawn in our home grow into a full and shining day, and let me be there to see the light grow. Amen.

verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
prayer: Lord, let {name}’s light shine before others, so they see good deeds and glorify you. Even now, this little one brings light into every room: smiles that make strangers smile back, joy that warms our family. Let {name} grow up shining, pointing people toward you by kindness and love. Amen.

verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
prayer: Father, you are our light and our salvation; whom shall we fear? You are the stronghold of our lives; of whom shall we be afraid? Let {name} grow up unafraid, because you are light and strength. Drive out the fears that whisper in my mind about this child. You are our safe place. Amen.

verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
prayer: Generous God, I am back again asking for wisdom, as you invited me to. The questions have changed since the early weeks: new foods, new sounds, new stages I have never seen before. You give generously and without finding fault. Give me wisdom for {name} today, and the humility to keep asking you instead of pretending I know it all. Amen.

verse: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
prayer: Lord, teach us to number our days, so that we may gain a heart of wisdom. These days with {name} go by so fast. Help me to treasure them and not wish them away. Let me notice the small moments that will soon be memories, and make wise choices about how I spend my time with this little one. Amen.

verse: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons…
prayer: Father, help me to keep my heart carefully, so I never forget what you have done for us. And let me make it known to {name}, and one day to {name}’s children. I want to tell the stories of your faithfulness to our family. Let me start now, telling {name} how you have carried us. Amen.

verse: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
prayer: Lord, in the fear of you there is strong confidence, and your children will have a place of refuge. Let my reverence for you become a refuge for {name}. As I honour you, let this little one find safety and security. Let our home be a strong place where {name} always feels protected and loved. Amen.

verse: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
prayer: Father, I commit my work as a parent to you, and I trust you to establish my plans. Some days I do not know if I am doing it right. I give you my efforts, my choices and my mistakes. Take what I offer for {name} and make it good. Establish our family on your faithfulness, not mine. Amen.

verse: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment…
prayer: Lord, let my love for {name} abound more and more, with knowledge and full insight. Love is not enough without wisdom, and wisdom is cold without love. Give me both. Help me to understand {name} better each day, and to love this little one in ways that truly help and bless. Amen.

verse: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
prayer: Father, you promise that all our children will be taught by you, and great will be their peace. I cannot teach {name} everything, and I do not have all the answers. But you do. Be {name}’s teacher in every season, through parents, teachers, friends and your own quiet voice. Let this child learn from you, and let the result be deep and lasting peace. Amen.

verse: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
prayer: Lord, you have loved {name} with an everlasting love, and you draw this little one with kindness. Before I ever loved {name}, you did. Your love will outlast mine. Draw {name} close throughout life with gentle kindness. Let this child never doubt being loved by you, forever and always. Amen.

verse: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
prayer: Father, love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things and endures all things. Give me that kind of love for {name}: love that endures the long nights, believes the best, hopes for the future and never gives up. Let {name} grow up resting in that strong, faithful love. Amen.

verse: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
prayer: Lord, nothing in all creation can separate {name} from your love in Christ Jesus: not death, not life, not angels, not powers, not anything present or to come. Let this truth be the foundation of {name}’s security. Whatever happens, this little one is held by a love that cannot be broken. Amen.

verse: We love him, because he first loved us.
prayer: Father, we love because you first loved us. Every bit of love in our home starts with you. Let {name} grow up loving you because of how deeply you love this little one. Let my love for {name} be a small echo of your great love, pointing this child back to you. Amen.

verse: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
prayer: Lord, though the mountains move and the hills shake, your steadfast love will not depart from {name}, and your covenant of peace will not be removed. When life feels unstable, let this promise hold firm. Be {name}’s unshakeable love through every change: new homes, new schools, new friendships and goodbyes. Whatever moves around this child, let your love stay exactly where it is. Amen.

verse: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
prayer: Father, many waters cannot quench love, and floods cannot drown it. Let the love in our family be that strong. Let tiredness, arguments and busy seasons never wash away our love for {name}, or {name}’s love for you. Make our home a place of strong, enduring love that weathers every storm, and let this little one always know where love can be found. Amen.

verse: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
prayer: Lord, see what great love you have given us, that we should be called your children, and that is what we are. Let {name} know that identity from the very start: a child of God, loved and claimed. Before grades, friends or achievements tell {name} who to be, let this truth speak first and loudest, and shape how this child sees everything else in life. Amen.

verse: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
prayer: Father, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly. Let this be our habit: as {name} wakes and stretches and reaches for me, let me reach for you. Hear my requests for this little one today. Teach {name} to begin each day with you too, expecting good things from your hand. Amen.

verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
prayer: Lord, you tell me not to be anxious about anything, but to bring everything to you in prayer, with thanks. So here it is: health for {name}, wisdom for me, peace for our home, and all the small worries I carry around all day. I hand them to you now. Thank you for listening. Guard my heart with your peace instead. Amen.

verse: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you…
prayer: Father, you say ask, and it will be given; seek, and we will find; knock, and the door will be opened. I am asking for {name}: for health, for faith, for a good life. I am seeking your will, and knocking on your door. Thank you that you love to answer. Amen.

verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
prayer: Lord, you say, call to me and I will answer you, and tell you great and hidden things you have not known. I call to you for {name} today. Answer me. Show me things I cannot see on my own. Reveal your plans and your goodness to our family. Amen.

verse: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
prayer: Lord Jesus, your disciples asked you to teach them to pray. I ask the same, for me and for {name}. Teach us to pray simply and honestly. Let {name} grow up talking to you as naturally as talking to me. Let our home be a place of prayer, where your name is spoken often. Amen.

verse: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
prayer: Father, you are near to all who call on you, to all who call on you in truth. Be near to {name} today. Let this little one never feel far from you. And let me call on you often, honestly and simply, as I care for this child you have given me. Amen.

verse: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
prayer: Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy in our home. May your kingdom come in {name}’s life. May your will be done in this family as it is in heaven. Teach {name} to pray these words, and more than that, to mean them. Let this child grow up longing for your kingdom. Amen.

verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
prayer: Lord, before you formed {name} in the womb you knew this little one, and before birth you set this life apart. You were not surprised by {name}’s arrival; you had been planning it all along. Whatever you have appointed this child to do, prepare {name} for it. Let this little one grow into the calling you have already written, with joy and courage. Amen.

verse: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
prayer: Father, you called {name} from the womb and spoke this name before I ever chose it. Every time I say {name} out loud, remind me that you said it first. Let this child grow up knowing that being called by you is the most important thing about a name. Use {name}’s life to speak of you to people near and far. Amen.

verse: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me. Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
prayer: Lord, you have searched {name} and you know this little one completely. You know when {name} sits down and when {name} gets up, even the wriggles and the half-sleeps. You understand thoughts that are not yet words. What a comfort that you know my child better than I do. Help me to know {name} more each day, guided by you. Amen.

verse: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself…
prayer: Father, you are {name}’s Redeemer, the One who formed this little body in the womb. You made all things, stretched out the heavens and spread out the earth, and still you bent down to shape one small child. The God of the stars is the God of our nursery. Let that wonder never fade in me, and let {name} grow up amazed by it too. Amen.

verse: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
prayer: Lord, you have carried {name} since before birth, and you promise to carry this child even to old age and grey hair. You made {name}, and you will bear and rescue. When I think of all the years ahead that I may not see, I rest in this: you will still be carrying {name} long after my arms are tired. Amen.

verse: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost…
prayer: Father, when Mary greeted Elizabeth, the baby leapt for joy in the womb. Even before birth, little ones respond to your presence. Let {name} leap with joy at your nearness all life long. Fill this child with your Holy Spirit from the earliest days, and let our home be full of the kind of joy that makes little hearts jump. Amen.

verse: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace…
prayer: Lord, it pleased you to set {name} apart before birth and to call this little one by your grace. Nothing {name} does will earn that calling; it is all your gift. Let this child grow up resting in grace, not striving to prove anything. Reveal yourself to {name} in your good time, and let this life make your goodness known. Amen.

verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
prayer: Father, let {name} dwell in the shelter of the Most High and rest in the shadow of the Almighty. Let this child say of you, my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust. Long before {name} can say those words, let our home be built in that shelter, so that trust in you is the air this little one breathes. Amen.

verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
prayer: Lord, your name is a strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe. When {name} is scared, let this little one run first to us, and as the years go by, to you. Teach {name} to call on your name in trouble. Be a strong tower over our home today, high above every danger we can and cannot see. Amen.

verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
prayer: Father, you are our rock, our fortress and our deliverer, our shield and our stronghold. As {name} begins to sit up and look around at the big world, be the steady rock under this little life. When everything else wobbles, let {name} find in you a place that never moves. Thank you that our family is built on you. Amen.

verse: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
prayer: Lord, you are good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and you know those who take refuge in you. You know {name}. You know every hiccup, every sniffle and every new tooth pushing through. On the troubled days, be our stronghold. Let {name} grow up knowing that trouble is never stronger than your goodness. Amen.

verse: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
prayer: Father, your angel camps around those who honour you and delivers them. Set your angels around {name} like a guard around a tent. Around the cot, the high chair, the car seat and the pram. Deliver this little one from every danger. Let me rest knowing that {name} is surrounded on every side by your care. Amen.

verse: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
prayer: Lord, you are a stronghold for the oppressed, a safe place in times of trouble. Thank you that your shelter is for the weak and the small, for {name} and for every child who needs you. Let {name} grow up with a heart for those who are struggling, and let our home be a refuge for others, as you are a refuge for us. Amen.

verse: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
